title: NASA Sun sheet prints photosphere composition H 90.965% and He 8.889% without saying number or mass
summary: The sheet lists major photosphere elements as H 90.965% and He 8.889%, and does not say whether the percent is by number or by mass.
body: Under Photosphere Composition the sheet prints major elements H - 90.965%, He - 8.889%, and minor elements in ppm: O 774, C 330, Ne 112, N 102, Fe 43, Mg 35, Si 32, S 15. The sheet does not say whether those percents are number fractions or mass fractions. This card does not choose one. The same block lists a sun spot cycle of 11.4 yr. Last Updated line: 9 May 2024.
